250-779-1479-5414-8293.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5414-8293.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5414-8293.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

2324-4681-5170-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

2390-3966-4205.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3966-4205.description:
Gain life.
Bloodthirsty Aerialist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3629-4691-4971.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
3629-4691-4971.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2 until your library is empty, preventing a game loss with Cloudsteel Kirin.

1479-2841-6926-7889.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-6926-7889.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2557-4094-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-3129-4094-5478-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
851-3129-4094-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1636-2681-4348-7870.description:
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token under an opponent's control.
When the Spirit enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
Activate Hawkeye by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the Spirit token. This'll destroy it due to it having 0 toughness.
Hawkeye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-5241-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-5241-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Naga Fleshcrafter and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-5241-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

862-2459-5049-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-2459-5049-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

2043-3621-4779.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

2308-4871-5231-6752.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4871-5231-6752.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Trudge Garden triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Haliya triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

1495-4613-7289.description:
Activate Leonardo by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Leonardo triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

483-4050-5170-6132.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

586-5256-5258-5618-7056.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

974-1305-2024-4417-6674.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Rydia by paying {5} and tapping it, returning There and Back Again from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. As There and Back Again enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing the finality counter from There and Back Again.
Resolve the There and Back Again trigger, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering its ability, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate eleven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}{W}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Rydia and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

997-3734-4375.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

2719-5756-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

1494-6670.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Jenova triggers, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2743-5487-6570.description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Molten Duplication and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Molten Duplication copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2084-3853.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2084-3853.description:
Cast Mirage Mockery by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

1308-2457-3480-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1550-4251-4885.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1550-4251-4885.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2511-2523-5559.description:
Cast Nazgûl by paying {2}{B}.
Nazgûl enters, triggering its first activated ability, causing the Ring to tempt you; choose Nazgûl as your Ring-bearer, making it legendary.
Nazgûl's second activated ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Wraith you control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Nazgûl.
Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Nazgûl that's a 2/2 Zombie.
Resolve the ability from step 4, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat from step 2.

969-3259-3973-4050.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four permanents of any color on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature you control except Rith.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-3973-4050.description:
Deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Rith trigger, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least four 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Saproling token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

914-2534-3314.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2534-3314.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it and Coercive Recruiter trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Chulane and giving it haste until end of turn.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control six or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

638-819-2492.description:
Cast Bonus Round by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Thrumming Stone triggers, revealing the top four cards of your library and putting them on the bottom of your library.
Resolve Bonus Round, copying all instants and sorceries cast after it this turn.
Cast any other spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Cast Memory Lapse by paying {1}{U}, targeting that spell.
Bonus Round and Thrumming Stone trigger.
Resolve the Bonus Round trigger, creating a copy of Memory Lapse, targeting the original Memory Lapse.
Resolve the copy of Memory Lapse, countering the original Memory Lapse and putting it on top of your library.
Resolve the Thrumming Stone trigger from step 6, revealing the top four cards of your library and casting Memory Lapse without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 6.

2034-4891-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Atsushi, adding {C}{C}.
Atsushi dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate two of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Atsushi from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
